after_text: {n}Wenduag left a hare's head on Vellexia's pillow and a knife in her door. Vellexia returned both, pinning the head to Wenduag's bed. The next time the huntress followed her into a dark corridor, the succubus caught her wrist and pulled her close. "You brought the knife. Must I do everything else?" Wenduag laughed, drew the blade with her free hand and cut the clasp from Vellexia's gown. Vellexia caught that hand too. "Better. Now put it away." Wenduag put the blade away and caught Vellexia by the waist. The succubus pulled her into the alcove, her open gown brushing the huntress's hands. Wenduag answered her kiss and drew her closer.
